name: Guangzhou Goaland Energy Conservation Tech. Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangzhou Goaland Energy Conservation Tech. Co., Ltd. engages in the design, research and development, production, and sales of thermal management equipment and control systems in China and internationally. The company offers high power electronics thermal management products, including semiconductor valves, static var compensator, high voltage frequency converter, big science and nuclear medicine, mechanical rotating components, and mechanical static components; and high power density devices thermal management products, such as electric energy storage and data center.
